capability: Let an AI grow the wiki under machine checks
title: AI writes. The gate checks.

hook.picture: Close: morning. A pod has written all night and the line has swollen into a huge pile of dots, stacked over the whale.
hook.words: The AI filled our wiki overnight.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The AI filled our wiki overnight. Which pages can I trust?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: small business owner on Monday morning

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: The pod pours dots in far faster than the whale can read. Three pours, each bigger, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: It writes faster than anyone can read.

stakes.body: Either you read everything and lose the week, or you trust it blind and ship its mistakes to customers.

solution_hint: Let it write small batches. Check each one.

metaphor.body: The AI pod hands over small batches. A gate measures each batch against three pins, the pod fixes what was named, and anything it cannot fix comes to the whale with a flag.

steps.picture: The pod hands over one small batch of five dots. A gate stands between the pod and the line.
The gate measures the batch against three pins. A duplicate dot glows, the gate closes, and the pod fixes just that dot by merging the twin. Second try passes.
steps.words: A machine checks. Not the writer.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.3). A batch fails three tries and its raw-sienna marks do not shrink. The gate stays shut and the pod carries the batch to the whale with a flag.
steps.words: Three tries, then it asks you.
steps.sound: Three thuds, then a held note.

steps.picture: Each passed batch lands on the line with a tick.
steps.words: Nothing saved quietly. Nothing dropped quietly.

real_case.claim: The memory graph added 111 new entities and 95 new sources, each new triple citing a source file. The gates read exact 0, orphans 0 and stubs 0.

honest_limit.picture: A nearly empty page with a title, one line, a source and links passes every pin. A pod reads it and gets nothing useful.
honest_limit.words: A near-empty page passes every check.

not_this.body: Passing checks is not a useful page.

ending_pattern.body: Same morning, same whale. Instead of a towering pile, a neat line and a short stack of two flagged batches wait for a human decision.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT a huge pile loomed over the whale. In the same framing only two flagged questions wait.

end_belief.body: Let AI write. Let machines check. You decide.

The pile sways.

The whale pulls one dot out to read it, and three more slide off the pile.
The whale holds one dot, the pile still towering.

beats.picture: The whale looks up at the pile. Hold.
Stillness, then SERIES.open title.

Three-times device: a pour of dots. Every 2 beats.

Everything stops. The pile splits into small neat stacks of five.

score_self.reason: Mechanical gates N3 N4 N5 N6 N8 N9 S1 and read time pass. The most broadly felt pain in the cluster, and the escalate-to-human ending is concrete. The case shows sourcing, not the batch loop itself. J1 unrun.
